title: geoproc.hand_model task kwargs
description: Canonical: geoai-django contracts/geoproc/hand_model.v1.json; vendored copy in flood_snap lab_service/contracts/. Sent by the platform to the queue `geoproc`: a HAND model of one delineated basin on one DEM at one stream-initiation threshold.

job_id.description: the platform Job id (UUID); also the Celery task id

basin_id.description: the BasinDelineation the model belongs to; its (snapped) outlet is sent below

stream_threshold_km2.description: stream-initiation threshold (sensitivity options, not recommended values)

reuse.description: v1.1 (2026-10-17): finished HAND models of sub-basins (same DEM, threshold and district; outlet inside this basin) the worker may paste instead of computing their area (flood_snap lab_service/hand/reuse.py). The worker checks each against the current terrain and method and records what it used or skipped in stats.reuse. Absent or empty: everything is computed.

job_id.description: its job: the worker first looks for the files in its own job folder

cells.description: cell count of its basin (stats.cells): a mismatch on the current terrain drops it

files.description: signed URLs by product kind: hand, dem_conditioning, stream_links, catchments, reaches, model_config
